facts.raw_span: a 2-year history of a mildly pruritic, erythematous, and gradually enlarging lesion on the proximal portion of his left calf
the lesion had appeared without an identifiable cause
no improvement with topical corticosteroids and antifungals for the previous 2 months
ill-defined, nonindurated, erythematous-violaceous plaque that was slightly raised but with an atrophic appearance
Band-like vascular proliferation in the upper dermis with no grenz zone
Round vascular spaces lined by a single layer of endothelial cells
No hemosiderin deposits found with Perls Prussian blue stain
Vascular channel endothelial cells were positive for CD34 and CD31 but negative for D2-40

Band-like vascular proliferation in the upper dermis with no grenz zone (hematoxylin-eosin)
Round vascular channels lined by a single layer of endothelial cells without atypia (hematoxylin-eosin)
CD34 immunostaining labels endothelial cells

concepts.why: The presence of band-like vascular proliferation in the upper dermis, round vascular spaces lined by a single layer of endothelial cells, and positivity for CD34 and CD31 are characteristic features of Kaposi's sarcoma.

The presence of band-like vascular proliferation in the upper dermis, round vascular spaces lined by a single layer of endothelial cells, and positivity for CD34 and CD31 could also be seen in angiosarcoma, although the lack of atypia and negative D2-40 staining make this less likely.

The presence of band-like vascular proliferation in the upper dermis and round vascular spaces lined by a single layer of endothelial cells could be seen in bacillary angiomatosis, although the clinical presentation and lack of other characteristic features make this less likely.
The presence of round vascular spaces lined by a single layer of endothelial cells and positive CD34 immunostaining labels endothelial cells is consistent with a hemangioma.
